seoTitle: About FilmEditRun | Video Production Cambridge & London
seoDescription: Meet FilmEditRun: an independent video production studio and post-house based in Cambridge. Filming conferences, brand stories, and podcasts across the UK.
headline: Films crafted with care, clarity, and *purpose*.
manifestoLead: FilmEditRun was built on a simple premise: corporate and brand films should feel alive, not manufactured. Based in Cambridge with agile crews filming on-location across London and the UK, we give clients direct access to experienced filmmakers who shoot and edit your story. You get cinema-grade results with clear communication and zero agency bloat.
manifestoQuote: Every project deserves a dedicated filmmaker, not a conveyor belt of account handlers. We shoot with intent and cut with discipline.
approachHeading: Calm leadership on set. *Direct collaboration in the cut.*
approachBody: Great corporate films come from a calm, well-run set where speakers feel at ease and technical details are handled quietly in the background. With FilmEditRun, the person listening to your brief is the one framing the shot, monitoring the sound, and cutting the master files. Whether we are filming on-location across the UK or polishing client-supplied footage in our Cambridge suites, you get direct communication, honest technical guidance, and finished films delivered with precision.
btsDescription: Unfiltered frames from sets, multi-camera live control rooms, and post-production suites.

btsItems.title: Wireless Camera Rig On Location
btsItems.caption: Rigged for rapid mobility during high-tempo conference coverage. Anamorphic glass, wireless video transmitter, and 12-hour continuous battery power.

btsItems.title: Multi-Cam Live Switch Deck
btsItems.caption: Director's multi-view monitoring 6 live SDI feeds with redundant hardware recording and instant replay triggers.

btsItems.title: Colour Timing & Mastering Suite
btsItems.caption: Calibrated reference monitoring in our darkroom suite, dialling in skin tones and rich cinematic contrast curves.

btsItems.title: Field Audio & Spatial Isolation
btsItems.caption: Dual boom and RF wireless microphones dialed in to reject venue echo and capture crystal-clear speaker nuance.

timelineDescription: How FilmEditRun evolved from an independent camera unit and edit suite into a full-scale cinematic production house filming across the UK.

milestones.title: One Camera, Two Lenses, Boundless Caffeine
milestones.description: FilmEditRun begins as an independent guerrilla post-production and camera unit in the UK, cutting short docs and music reels until 4 AM on single SSD arrays.

milestones.title: Multi-Camera Live Switch Debut
milestones.description: Engineered our first zero-latency 6-camera broadcast pipeline for high-stakes tech conferences, bridging television broadcast reliability with cinema-grade image capture.

milestones.title: Expanding Regional Studio Footprint
milestones.description: Established dedicated operational presence across Cambridge's science & tech cluster and London corridor, capturing global innovation summits, biomedical symposiums, and brand launches.

milestones.draftLabel: YELLOW REVISION: FULL CINEMA ACES PIPELINE
milestones.title: Zero-Compromise 4K HDR Workflows
milestones.description: Standardized end-to-end cinema colour pipelines with 10-bit 4:2:2 ProRes master captures, wireless director feeds, and cloud-synced daily review suites for clients worldwide.

milestones.draftLabel: FINAL SHOOTING SCRIPT: THE STUDIO TODAY
milestones.title: 500+ Projects Mastered, Ready for Roll Call
milestones.description: A dynamic, agile collective of filmmakers, editors, and sound artists delivering commercial prestige without the sluggish bloat of traditional legacy agencies.

ctaHeading: Have a project or event in mind?
ctaText: Whether you’re planning a multi-camera conference, a flagship brand film, or need fast post-production, we’re ready to help. Let’s talk through your ideas.
